text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Don't be so down, Flower-chan.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you relied on me, and yet I 
couldn't pull it off properly...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Yeah, a little.

"According to her, a friend asked her to 
embroider a specific flower onto a 
handkerchief as a gift for their mother. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I misunderstood the color of the flowers I 
was asked for and kept going anyway...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... What am I supposed to do...? 
After they counted on me like that...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there, it's okay~ I have a great 
idea.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For example, by adding patterns in the 
same color as the mistake to create depth 
as a background for the correctly colored 
flowers—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing! With this, it doesn't look 
weird at all!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's good.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Creek-san! You really are 
amazing, Creek-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
She's always so calm, kind, and knows so 
many things...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Someone like me is still nowhere 
near catching up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a calm, reliable, and 
wonderful person like Creek-san soon too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sure you'll grow into a much more 
wonderful adult than me, Flower-chan.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true. Because I... haven't 
done anything yet...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, in that case, I'll prove it to you♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The one who grew those flowers over there 
was you, right, Flower-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I like flowers too, but I'm no expert.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Raising something is very difficult; 
passion alone isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It takes knowledge, patience, and a kind 
heart... And Flower-chan has all of those.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Creek-san...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even if she doesn't rush, Flower-chan will 
grow into an even more wonderful girl.
choice_data_list: It's okay to lean on others for now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look, even professional trainers who raise 
Umamusume say so themselves.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Slowly, without rushing... Let's aim to 
become the person you want to be, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Like nurturing flowers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes! Without rushing, taking it 
slowly... I'll help myself grow, too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Creek-san!

At Super Creek's words, Nishino Flower 
broke into a smile like a blooming flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, being around Creek-san might make 
me rely on her a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. Shall we give it a try, then? 
F・i・r・s・t, a big squeeze♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

Held in Super Creek's embrace, Nishino 
Flower smiled happily, though caught by 
surprise.
